sci-repo-y10-sby-2020-evomc-mc-1.title: Year 10 Science — Selection,speciation and fossil evidence (original source MC)
sci-repo-y10-sby-2020-evomc-mc-1.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: According to Darwin’s theory of natural selection, individuals who survive are the ones best adapted for their environment. Their survival is due to the?
options: Possession of inherited adaptations that maximise fitness.
questions.explanation: Inherited adaptations can increase reproductive success in a particular environment. Fitness is not simply strength or survival in every possible environment.

questions.prompt: A factor that is necessary for the formation of a new species is?
questions.explanation: Reproductive isolation is central to speciation under the biological species concept. “Species isolation”is the intended option;geographical separation is one mechanism but is not always necessary.

questions.prompt: A transitional form in the fossil record is a species:
options: That is a common ancestor to several species that come after it
That has changed from one species to another over its life time
That has characteristics of all species that follow it
With characteristics of two or more groups at a particular level of classification.
questions.explanation: Transitional fossils combine characteristics associated with different groups. They need not be the direct ancestor of every later species,and an individual does not change species during its lifetime.

questions.prompt: In the ladder analogy of the DNA molecule, the "rungs" of the ladder are:
questions.explanation: Paired nitrogenous bases form the DNA ladder’s rungs.

questions.prompt: If a DNA molecule is found to be composed of 40% thymine, what percentage of adenine would be expected.
questions.explanation: 40%adenine for ordinary double-stranded DNA,because A pairs with T.

questions.prompt: A stretch of chromosome that codes for a trait can be called a(n):
questions.explanation: A gene is a DNAsequence contributing to a functional product;many traits involve severalgenes,and not every gene simply codes for one visibletrait.

options: A base and an amino acid.
A phosphate, a base and a sugar.
questions.explanation: A DNA nucleotide contains a phosphate group,a deoxyribose sugar and a nitrogenous base.

questions.prompt: Meiosis is a type of cell division that produces:
questions.explanation: Gametes is the intended answer for the animal/human context. In plants,meiosis produces spores,so context matters.

questions.prompt: A cell with a diploid number of 24 undergoes meiosis, how many chromosomes are in each daughter cell?
questions.explanation: 12chromosomes in each haploid product after normal meiosis from a diploid cell with24.
Phenotype means observable/measurable characteristics,not just DNAsequence;“physical appearance”is the best supplied option.
